capture_mode: conservative saved-source cross-corpus legacy address enrichment
source_note: The canonical corpus was cross-joined across already saved Savills appearance shards by exact auction date and lot number to locate legacy PropertyAuctions rows still missing addresses. Four matches were retained only where the saved alternate source also agreed on locality and compatible property class, with transaction price or auction outcome where available. Twenty date-and-lot collisions with conflicting locality or property class were left unchanged. This consolidates already banked evidence; it does not assert catalogue completeness.
